acceptanceCriteria: When a changed file is a test-support module, affected reports the statically importing test files as a narrowed candidate set, still labelled as a fallback.
The plan reports changed symbols so callers can see additive-only changes.
Dynamic resolution in one sub-project does not drop narrowing for statically resolved sub-projects.
Tests cover each case; the fallback stays fail-closed.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1294 (opened 2026-10-20). Feature request; not yet specified. When a change touches a widely imported test-support module (a shared fixture/registry file), `affected` selects 0 units and falls back to FULL_RELEVANT_SUITE with scope UNKNOWN. That is fail-closed and correct, but it makes every shared-support change cost a full suite. In one case discovery also refused because a sub-project resolves dependencies dynamically. Ask: - When the changed file is a test-support module, compute the importing test files from the static import graph and report them as a narrowed candidate set, still labelled as a fallback. - Report which symbols changed, so callers can see whether only additive exports changed. - When dynamic resolution blocks discovery in one sub-project, keep the narrowing for the sub-projects that resolve statically. See beamfall/corvint#1294 for the full text.
title: affected: narrow selection by import graph when a shared fixture module changes (issue #1294)
